title: Pattaya Gym Directory — Recently Added
description: Latest verified gyms, Muay Thai camps, dive operators, golf courses and sport venues added to the Pattaya Gym Directory.

items.title: ISS Boxing and Muay Thai
items.content_text: Central Pattaya boxing and Muay Thai gym with separate class, gym-access and recovery-room products on its current official classes page.

items.title: Kombat Group Thailand
items.content_text: Huai Yai residential camp selling package-based Muay Thai, boxing, MMA and BJJ stays with accommodation, meals and facility access.

items.title: Rambaa Somdet M16
items.content_text: East Pattaya contact-first Muay Thai and MMA gym with split training periods and conflicting 2026 public price posts.

items.title: Lumpinee Boxing Stadium
items.content_text: Active Bangkok stadium with current operator-published Friday, Saturday and selected morning Muay Thai event cards.

items.title: Rajadamnern Stadium
items.content_text: Bangkok Muay Thai stadium with a current seven-night event calendar and variable seating tiers; not a Pattaya venue.

items.title: Rage Fight Academy
items.content_text: South Pattaya combat camp with Muay Thai, boxing, BJJ, MMA, functional training, accommodation and a pool.

items.title: Silk Muay Thai
items.content_text: East Pattaya residential Muay Thai camp with package-based training, private rooms, meals and recovery facilities.

items.title: Sudsakorn Muay Thai Gym
items.content_text: East Pattaya Muay Thai gym with twice-daily Monday-Saturday training and a current six-line public rate card.

items.title: Sitpholek Institute of Muay Thai Techniques
items.content_text: Active Khao Talo Muay Thai gym with a confirmed phone and location but no current public tariff or class timetable.

items.title: Jungle Gym Pattaya (former CrossFit Pattaya affiliate)
items.content_text: Functional-fitness gym with published class windows whose former CrossFit affiliate listing is now marked departed.

items.title: Elite Gym & Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: Air-conditioned Sukhumvit gym with a THB 300 day pass, memberships, classes and separately priced functional training.

items.title: Anytime Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: One record covering separate Again Pattaya and Bukit Point clubs, both with 24-hour member access and branch-specific unanswered pricing questions.

items.title: Fitness 7 Pattaya
items.content_text: Twenty-four-hour central Pattaya gym with a large mixed-equipment floor, boxing ring, functional area and branch-wide published rates.

items.title: Castra Gym
items.content_text: Khao Talo gym combining general strength and cardio equipment with published Muay Thai and BJJ class pricing.

items.title: Cross Pattaya Pratamnak — Cloud Club
items.content_text: Hotel wellness amenity with published Cloud Club hours, saltwater-pool hours and no current public non-resident day pass.

items.title: ONE-D YOGA PATTAYA
items.content_text: Yoga studio in Wong Amat with split morning and evening operating periods on most days.

items.title: Balance Yoga Studio Pattaya
items.content_text: Pratamnak condominium studio offering yoga plus separate sound-healing and nail-board wellness sessions.

items.title: Treasure Hill Golf Club
items.content_text: Ban Bueng 18-hole, par-72 golf course with daily Maps hours, a pro shop and contact-first green fees.

items.title: Chee Chan Golf Resort
items.content_text: 18-hole Na Jomtien championship course with a dated 2026 public rate card, driving range and full golf-club facilities.

items.title: Chatrium Golf Resort Soi Dao Chanthaburi
items.content_text: Chanthaburi golf resort operating holes 10-18 only during the current 2026 enhancement phase.

items.title: Pattana Sports Resort
items.content_text: Si Racha resort with 27 holes, a 50-metre pool and a resident-restricted July 2026 early-bird golf offer.

items.title: St Andrews 2000 Golf Club
items.content_text: Ban Chang golf course and resort complex with published facilities and accommodation but no readable current public green-fee table.

items.title: Khao Kheow Country Club
items.content_text: Active Bang Phra golf club with daily hours and current society play, but no dependable first-hand visitor tariff.

items.title: Euro Badminton Club Pattaya
items.content_text: Operating local badminton club with current Maps phone, Plus Code and weekly hours; prices and facilities require direct confirmation.

items.title: Pattaya Badminton & Tennis Inter Club
items.content_text: East Pattaya racquet club with confirmed tennis, badminton and pickleball activity but no fully current dated public rate card.

items.title: PR Pattaya Pickleball
items.content_text: Pratamnak pickleball club with two full-sized courts, beginner coaching and a live booking form, now operating publicly as PR Pattaya Pickleball.

items.title: Pattaya Sports Club Association
items.content_text: Central Pattaya membership association covering sports information, discounts and golf administration rather than one on-site sports complex.

items.title: Manta Kids Pattaya
items.content_text: Indoor children’s swim-school branch at IG Center with age-based programmes from infants to four-stroke learners.

items.title: Pattaya Dive Centre
items.content_text: Tipp Plaza PADI 5 Star IDC with published Pattaya and Samae San trip, course and snorkelling prices.

items.title: No Limit Divers
items.content_text: Central Pattaya dive centre publishing fun-dive, beginner and Open Water products with current prices.
